title: Sierra raises $1.75 billion at a $30 billion valuation — customer-service agents double in six months
subtitle: Greenoaks and Lightspeed led the round for Bret Taylor's agent company, which says it works with almost half the Fortune 50 and is running above $400 million in annualized revenue.
author: AESOP AI Engine
body: Sierra announced on November 23 that it is raising $1.75 billion at a $30 billion valuation, led by Greenoaks and Lightspeed Venture Partners. The round roughly doubles its valuation in six months — Bloomberg reported a $15.8 billion mark in May. The company, founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor and Google App Engine co-creator Clay Bavor, builds customer-service AI agents and says it works with almost half the Fortune 50, with recurring revenue at an annualized rate above $400 million.

Sierra's pitch is outcome-based pricing — customers pay per resolved case rather than per seat or per API call. That model only works when the agent can actually close a conversation without a human, and Sierra's revenue number suggests enterprises are willing to bet it does. The company plans to spend the capital on engineering, go-to-market, and European and Asian expansion.

The round lands in a week of extraordinary AI-agent valuations — Cognition is reportedly in talks for more than $2 billion at a $75 billion mark, two months after a $48 billion round. Together they mark the moment when agent companies, not foundation-model companies, became the premium valuation category. Sierra's $30 billion is roughly a third of what Anthropic traded at on its first full day as a public company.

A note for learners: watch pricing models to understand where confidence is highest. Per-seat pricing says 'we help your humans.' Per-call pricing says 'we're a tool.' Per-outcome pricing says 'we replace the thing you were paying people to do' — and when enterprises accept it, they're saying they believe it too. If you're building something agentic, ask yourself which of those three claims you can actually defend.
